description: This file defines the columns configuration for a user management data table, including custom rendering for each column, action buttons, and optional selection checkboxes. It leverages several UI libraries, manages user interactions like edit, delete, reset password, and formats user-related data.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Defines and returns an array of column configurations for a user info table, parameterized with UI roles, and action handlers, optionally including a selection column.
